preservation: Preserve discovery records; remove only from operating selection after root review.

exclusions.actual_subject: GOV54324.5; Angel Stadium disposition materials must use Anaheim Angels naming under the specified exemption.
exclusions.reason: Exclude. A special baseball-stadium naming condition in Anaheim supplies no residential repair, possession or departing-account condition. Its surplus-land heading does not establish housing relevance.

exclusions.actual_subject: BPC22974.2 tobacco retailer seizure/penalties; PRC42260 manufacture/import/sale/distribution prohibition for disposable vapes.
exclusions.reason: Exclude. This is product commerce and tobacco retail enforcement, not a rule for clearing or disposing of tenant belongings. Do not infer disposal duties from the battery/waste theme.

exclusions.actual_subject: GOV51283/51295; agricultural conservation contract cancellation fees and utility-scale solar conversion.
exclusions.reason: Exclude. No demonstrated residential work or outgoing-account connection; solar equipment at housing is not agricultural-land conversion for a certified generating facility. The retrieved official page showed enrolled text, whereas the register says chaptered; exclusion does not depend on resolving that status discrepancy.
exclusions.source_status_limitation: Official bill-text page retrieved during review displayed enrolled text; canonical register reports chaptered. Review did not resolve this conflict because the exclusion is independently supported by subject matter.

exclusions.actual_subject: WIC361.5; eligibility for child-welfare family reunification services after a parent's violent-felony conviction.
exclusions.reason: Exclude. This governs dependency case services, not residential physical standards, tenancy settlement, or a representative's authority over the tenant's account. Generic possible program relevance is insufficient.

exclusions.actual_subject: HSC1255.7, PEN271.5 and conforming education provisions; infant safe-surrender age, custody, site personnel and related instruction.
exclusions.reason: Exclude. Safe-surrender-site duties do not establish ordinary residential premises or departing-account duties.

exclusions.actual_subject: Office of Suicide Prevention focus on boys and young men, with legislative strategy reporting.
exclusions.reason: Exclude. Agency population priorities and reporting are not a housing-service condition or operating requirement for residential work/account resolution.

exclusions.actual_subject: PRC14549.1; quality incentive payments to recycling-program operators/certified entities for glass manufacturing feedstock.
exclusions.reason: Exclude. These processor/program payments do not impose resident/owner disposal terms or property refuse charges. A hired recycler's separate subsidy business is not enough.

exclusions.actual_subject: Appropriates payment for eight individually named actions against the state; reversion and urgency clauses.
exclusions.reason: Exclude. No general claims or settlement procedure is changed, and no selected housing account or work entitlement is identified. Named litigation payment is not a reason to include every state judgment appropriation.

exclusions.actual_subject: New WIC16516.7; virtual/monthly social-worker visits for nonminor dependents placed out of state, safeguards and agency guidelines.
exclusions.reason: Exclude. Out-of-state caseworker visits are not the selected California residential work/account branch. They do not establish unit inspections or account authority.

exclusions.actual_subject: HSC1324.29/.30 and Medi-Cal long-term-care reimbursement provisions; quality assurance fee/rate sunset extensions.
exclusions.reason: Exclude. Medical-provider reimbursement and its funding assessment are distinct from residential tenancy charges, refunds or repair finance.

exclusions.actual_subject: Changes the family resource center definition in child-abuse-prevention/multidisciplinary-team legislation.
exclusions.reason: Exclude. No demonstrated housing funding, residential work, tenant-account or representative-authority condition follows from the child-welfare service hub definition.

exclusions.actual_subject: EDC8234, WIC10209.7/10269; childcare/early-education program signatures and records.
exclusions.reason: Exclude. Its UETA references do not amend the general rule for rental notices, repair contracts or account delivery. Childcare program contracting is a separate activity.

exclusions.actual_subject: PEN933; court clerk's collection and transfer of grand-jury reports to State Archivist.
exclusions.reason: Exclude. This is grand-jury administrative archival procedure, not civil recovery or evidence rules for the chain.

exclusions.actual_subject: PRC1005; Outdoors for All initiative, Natural Resources Agency strategy updates and legislative reporting.
exclusions.reason: Exclude. Public recreation strategy does not create the account communications, privacy, payment or civil-remedy duties assigned in the register.
